homeTitle: Make a shared civic request measurable
problem: People need a clear way to support shared demands and contact public representatives in their own voice.
solution: Support the campaign, create a personal appeal, send it through your own channel, and optionally report a reply.

privacyBody:
We collect only the information needed to verify support, generate aggregate metrics, and moderate replies. Personalized appeal text is never stored.

We do not publish personal information without consent, sell data, or send appeals for you. Administrators may access submitted data only for campaign operation and moderation.

You may request deletion below. Operational backups are retained under the documented schedule. Contact the campaign operator for privacy questions.
